Chicken Katsu
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 3:37pm

Ingredients




5 pounds Chicken thighs, deboned
Salt
Pepper
Garlic powder
Flour
2 Eggs, beaten
Corn flake crumbs
Oil to deep fry
cup Ketchup
cup Shoyu, (soy sauce)
cup Sugar
2 teaspoons Worcestershire sauce
teaspoon Red pepper, ground
teaspoon Pepper

Preparation

1 Debone chicken and flatten each piece. Put salt, pepper, garlic salt and flour in small bag. Shake up deboned chicken in bag. Dip into eggs that have been beaten with a little water. Coat with cornflake crumbs. Deep fry until golden brown. Drain. Cut into bite-size pieces. Serve on a bed of lettuce with Katsu Sauce.
